# GitHub Copilot Instructions

Follow these repository guides before making changes:

- `AGENTS.md` — architecture invariants, commands, deployment, and scoped subdirectory guides (`src/AGENTS.md`, `backend/AGENTS.md`, `backend/migrations/AGENTS.md`)
- `DESIGN.md` — CSS tokens, semantic palette, z-index ladder, and canonical UI primitives
- `CODING_STANDARDS.md` — engineering judgment, code smells, and review standards

Always run `npm run check` (and `npm run test:backend` for backend changes) before finishing.
